text: Dear Citizen, this is an official notice from the Cyber Crime Investigation Cell. Your Aadhaar-linked number has been associated with a money laundering case. To avoid immediate arrest, you must join a confidential video verification within the next 60 minutes. Do not disclose this to anyone.

Important: A parcel registered in your name containing illegal substances has been intercepted at Mumbai customs. An FIR has been filed. Please cooperate with the investigating officer on WhatsApp video immediately to clear your name and protect your bank accounts from seizure.

We regret to inform you that a non-bailable warrant has been issued against you. As a courtesy, you may settle the matter digitally today by transferring a refundable security deposit to the RBI-verified account shared by the officer. Kindly treat this matter as strictly confidential.
आपके आधार नंबर का इस्तेमाल एक गंभीर वित्तीय अपराध में हुआ है। गिरफ्तारी से बचने के लिए तुरंत वीडियो कॉल पर जांच अधिकारी से जुड़ें और इस बात को किसी को न बताएं।
सीबीआई कार्यालय से सूचना: आपके नाम से जुड़े बैंक खाते में संदिग्ध लेनदेन मिले हैं। अपने खाते को सुरक्षित करने के लिए जांच पूरी होने तक राशि सत्यापन खाते में भेजें।
Aapke naam par ek case register hua hai, warrant nikal chuka hai. Abhi video call pe officer se baat kijiye aur ghar walon ko mat bataiye, warna aaj hi arrest ho sakta hai.
Customs department se: aapke parcel mein drugs mile hain. Investigation clear karne ke liye verification amount transfer kijiye, paisa jaanch ke baad wapas aa jayega.

Dear valued customer, your account will be temporarily restricted today as your KYC details are incomplete. Please complete the quick re-verification using the secure link below to continue uninterrupted banking services.
Hello! We noticed your PAN is not linked with your savings account. To prevent suspension within 24 hours, install our official verification app from the link and follow the on-screen steps.

Your electricity connection will be disconnected tonight at 9:30 PM because your last bill update was not verified. Please contact our officer immediately and update your details through the app we send you.
प्रिय ग्राहक, आपका केवाईसी अपडेट नहीं हुआ है, इसलिए आपका खाता आज बंद कर दिया जाएगा। नीचे दिए गए लिंक से ऐप डाउनलोड करके तुरंत विवरण अपडेट करें।
Aapka bank account KYC pending hone ki wajah se aaj block ho jayega. Link se app install karke 5 minute mein update kar lijiye, koi charge nahi lagega.
Bijli vibhag: aapka bill update nahi hua hai, aaj raat connection kaat diya jayega. Turant officer ko call karke details update karwaiye.

Congratulations! You have been shortlisted for a flexible work-from-home opportunity. Simply like YouTube videos and earn up to Rs 5,000 per day. Reply YES to receive your first paid task and a welcome bonus.
Thank you for completing today's tasks. Your earnings of Rs 2,400 are ready, but to unlock the withdrawal you need to complete one prepaid merchant task. The amount will be returned with commission.
Hi, I'm Riya from the hiring team. We offer part-time online assignments rating hotels and products. No experience needed, payouts daily. Shall I add you to our Telegram onboarding group?
घर बैठे रोज़ 3000 से 8000 रुपये कमाएं। बस वीडियो लाइक करें और स्क्रीनशॉट भेजें। पहला टास्क पूरा करते ही बोनस आपके खाते में।
Aapka profile select ho gaya hai part time job ke liye. Daily tasks complete kijiye aur 5000 tak kamaiye. Next level unlock karne ke liye chhota sa deposit dena hoga, sab wapas milega.

Exclusive invitation: join our private investors' circle led by SEBI-registered experts. Members earned 32% returns last month on IPO allotments. Limited seats remain, click to join the VIP group today.
Your institutional trading account has been approved. Deposit funds through the app shared by your mentor to buy the upcoming block deal at a guaranteed discount before market open.
हमारे वीआईपी ग्रुप से जुड़ें और हर हफ़्ते 30% तक मुनाफ़ा कमाएं। अनुभवी विशेषज्ञ आपको सही शेयर बताएंगे, सीमित सीटें बची हैं।
Sir, kal ka IPO allotment hamare group ke members ko pakka milega. Abhi app pe paisa daal dijiye, profit double hone ki guarantee hai.
Dear customer, a refund of Rs 4,999 for your cancelled order has been approved. To receive it instantly, please scan the QR code we share and enter your UPI PIN to accept the amount.
We apologise for the delayed delivery. As compensation you are eligible for a cashback of Rs 2,000. Our support executive will call you to process it; please keep your payment app open.
आपके रद्द किए गए ऑर्डर का रिफंड तैयार है। राशि पाने के लिए भेजा गया क्यूआर कोड स्कैन करें और अपना यूपीआई पिन डालें।
Madam, aapka refund atak gaya hai. Hum ek payment request bhej rahe hain, usko accept karke PIN daal dijiye, paisa turant aapke account mein aa jayega.
123456 is your OTP for login to your bank account. Do not share this OTP with anyone, including bank staff. It is valid for 5 minutes.
Reminder: your KYC is due for periodic update. Please visit your nearest branch or update through the official bank app. We will never ask for your PIN or OTP by call or SMS.
RBI cautions customers: police, CBI or courts never ask you to transfer money over a video call. If someone does, hang up and report it at 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in.
Your refund of Rs 499 for order 4021 has been credited to your original payment method. No action is needed from you.
Hi, this is Neha from the HR team at our office. Your interview is confirmed for Monday at 11 AM. Please bring your ID and certificates. See you then!
Your electricity bill of Rs 1,240 for October is generated. Pay by 15 Nov through the official app or website to avoid a late fee.
Mom, I reached the hostel safely. The train was late but everything is fine. Will call you after dinner.
Market update from your broker: the Nifty closed 0.6% higher today. Review your portfolio in the app. Investments are subject to market risks.
आपका ओटीपी 482915 है। इसे किसी के साथ साझा न करें। बैंक कभी भी कॉल पर ओटीपी नहीं मांगता।
आपका बिजली बिल 860 रुपये है। अंतिम तिथि 20 नवंबर है। भुगतान केवल आधिकारिक ऐप या वेबसाइट से करें।
बेटा, शाम को सब्ज़ी लेते हुए आना और दादी की दवाई भी ले आना।
Bhaiya kal 10 baje tak shop khulegi, aap order le jaana. Payment UPI se ho jayega.
Aapka order deliver ho gaya hai. Koi problem ho toh app mein help section se baat kijiye.
Sir, aapki salary account mein credit ho gayi hai. Payslip HR portal pe available hai.
